newsitem.title: USA: GeoResources still working on oil well.
newsitem.headline: GeoResources still working on oil well.

text.p: GeoResources Inc said Friday it was working toward completion on its Ballantyne-State/Steinhaus H1 horizontal oil well located in the Wayne Field, Bottineau County, N.D.

The completion process has taken substantially longer than the company originally estimated, primarily because the wellbore was found to contain substantially more leftover drill cuttings than expected, it said.

GeoResources said time and expense was needed to clean the well thoroughly to achieve its potential. Preliminary swab cleaning and testing indicate the well should be oil productive and have oil production potential similar to the company's other horizontal wells in the Wayne Field, it said. The company said it was continuing completion operations as quickly as possible and hopes to have the well producing on a down hole pump within a few weeks.
